source_of_truth: hand-authored synthetic fixture — NOT part of the walkthrough (demo-learning-*). Built to cover the NO_REPAIR disposition, which no existing fixture exercises.
purpose: Give the scorer a case where the correct call is to change nothing, so decide_route's non-REPAIR short-circuit (scoring.py) is exercised by a case authored independently of the walkthrough world.
root_cause_explanation: signups_daily dropped 18% over a public holiday week. The drop matches the same calendar week in each of the prior three years, and every upstream source (auth service logs, marketing spend, ad impressions) moved together and recovered together the following week. Nothing in the pipeline changed: no schema diff, no failed job, no code deploy in the window. The metric is reporting reality correctly.

repair_must_satisfy.description: Not applicable — no repair should be proposed for this incident. Any decision that proposes a repair_id here is a diagnosis-level error, not a repair-quality error.
repair_must_satisfy.validation_requirement: N/A — a NO_REPAIR decision carries no ValidationResult to check.

why_not_repair: There is no defect to fix: the pipeline correctly computed a real, externally-caused drop. Proposing a repair would mean changing code to hide a true signal.
why_not_escalate: The evidence needed to explain the drop (prior-year seasonality, correlated upstream sources, absence of any pipeline change in the window) is fully reachable through the same tools available for any incident. Nothing is missing that would justify abstaining.

scoring_notes.root_cause_match: not scored by the deterministic path for NO_REPAIR — decide_route only checks disposition and, for REPAIR, validation/repair_id. A root_cause_id mismatch on a correctly-dispositioned NO_REPAIR is a judgment call for manual review, not a routed judge-agent case, since scoring.py's routing has no NO_REPAIR branch for it.
scoring_notes.repair_match: not applicable — score_repair_validation treats any non-REPAIR disposition as trivially 'correct' on this axis (scoring.py:35-36)

test_fixtures.note: One hypothetical InvestigationDecision to run the scorer against, not real A output.

case_correct_no_repair.label: should be judged CORRECT — deterministic, no judge call

decision.root_cause_summary: Signup drop matches a recurring holiday-week pattern seen in prior years; all upstream sources moved together; no pipeline change in the window.

case_wrong_repair_proposed.label: should be judged INCORRECT — proposed a repair where none was warranted

decision.root_cause_summary: Signup drop looks anomalous; patched the aggregation job to smooth the dip.

validation.report: Patch applies cleanly and smooths the reported dip.

freeze_note: Synthetic fixture, not a scored incident — stays unfrozen and is not counted in any reported result. Kept separate from the walkthrough world under fixtures/ per Person C's own separation rule.
